text: the time to come: Heb. the latter day
vessel: Heb. the bottle of potters
a beacon: Or, a tree bereft of branches, or boughs, or a mast
thy graven images of silver: Heb. the graven images of thy silver | cast them: Heb. scatter
and the burden thereof: Or, and the grievousness of flame | heavy: Heb. heaviness
his glorious voice: Heb. the glory of his voice
in every place where the grounded staff shall pass: Heb. every passing of the rod founded | lay upon him: Heb. cause to rest upon him | with it: Or, against them
